history.notes: Patch release: embeds and verifies the SHA-256 sidecar required by the offline NSIS installer payload.

Governance gate generalized to accept arbitrary real provider evidence bundles (#212); candidate-identity drift detection in evidence_generator; agent editor provider/model selection preserved during catalog loading; first-run system state decoupled from workspace binding.

Fix: the offline NSIS installer never called install-embedded-payload.ps1 -Finalize after a verified successful install, so the .BAGO-rollback backup was never cleaned up. On the next install/update, the payload script's crash-recovery heuristic (presence of electron-viewer\BAGO.exe) misread that stale backup as an interrupted swap and restored it before reinstalling, corrupting the rollback safety net on every normal update. Adds -Finalize call after verification and a regression test.
